name: ssmforge
summary: Standalone HF architecture analyzer (`ssmforge arch`). Inspects any HuggingFace model and reports architectural quirks — attention biases, fused QKV/gate-up, tied embeddings, GQA, MQA, MoE, sliding window, LayerScale, soft-capping, partial RoPE, MLP type, norm type. Outputs structured JSON + human-readable summary.
author: SSMForge Contributors
